name: B10-0542/2026 (Renew) – Case of Paata Burchuladze and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Paata Burchuladze and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the case of Paata Burchuladze, a 71-year-old opera singer and dual Georgian-Austrian citizen sentenced in May 2026 to seven years in prison after protests in Tbilisi. The Parliament calls the charges politically motivated and wants him and other people jailed for using their basic rights set free. It also asks Georgia to hold fair appeal hearings, give him proper medical care and let him see his family and consular officials.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and a set of demands to Georgia.
- **Who it affects:** Burchuladze, other jailed opposition figures, protesters, journalists and activists in Georgia.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to European Union institutions and Georgia. The Parliament urges targeted measures against officials responsible for rights violations.
